stories.title: Sources: Warriors, Curry reach 2-year extension worth $116 million
stories.summary: Warriors star Stephen Curry agreed to a two-year, $116 million contract extension, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Friday, ultimately opting for a pay cut and security over a max contract.

stories.title: No. 5 Indiana loses RB Richard, escapes Northwestern
stories.summary: Indiana starting running back Turbo Richard left Friday's 29-23 win over Northwestern with a right lower-leg injury in the first half and did not return.

stories.title: White Sox's Montgomery sets single-season strikeout record with 224
stories.summary: White Sox infielder Colson Montgomery set the record for most strikeouts in a season with his 224th on Friday.

stories.title: Yankees, Red Sox to meet in playoffs for 7th time
stories.summary: The Yankees and Red Sox both talked up the clubs' long-standing rivalry with mutual respect ahead of their best-of-three wild-card series.

stories.title: SEC irked LSU is trying to dismiss lawsuit with concerns 'unresolved'
stories.summary: The SEC is "deeply disappointed" LSU tried to dismiss its lawsuit against the university stemming from an attempt to add former NFL players to the Tigers' roster.
